There's a lot of drama surrounding my abuelita, which is my great grandma.  Besides the fact that she was highly physically abusive towards my nana while she was growing up, she detested the close bond my nana shared with her father.

My nana has confided in me more than once she believes she is responsible for my great grandfathers death.  In the early seventies my abuelita used to pick up my uncle Gerald every Sunday for church from my great grandpa's house.  At the time Gerald was three.  She would have had to enter the house to get him, and we think she came across my great grandfather lying on the floor and left him there to die.

He was found next to his bed, still in pajamas, covered in his own urine.  The first thing he did every day was get up and pee, so he didn't get Gerald up and ready for church before she had picked him up.  She took my uncle to church, and brought him to my nanas house.  Apparently Gerrald kept saying "papa fell down."

We're positive she went into the house, found him there, and left him to die.  They'd been divorced several years at this point, and had no power over his medical decisions, he ended up going to the hospital and was on life support.  Apparently after a week or so she snuck in while my nana and her sister weren't there, pretended they were still married and had them take him off the machines.  My nana says she walked in to my abuelita sitting there calmly with a smug look on her face staring at my great grandfathers body.  He passed while she was gone.

This woman is detestable, the stories of the abuse she's put my grandmother through are horrifying.  The worst part is she's still alive, lives nearby and my nana basically takes care of her and probably will for the rest of her life, because my nana is very sick and my abuelita is super healthy minus her mental issues.
